text:
Priya: RFC follow-up - need a safe fallback when Private Endpoint paths fail for customers that can't or won't use EIPs. Goals: preserve tenant attribution, minimize ops friction, and avoid SNAT where possible.

Liam: Transport options: WireGuard/VXLAN (preserve src), DTLS/UDP userland tunnels, TLS-over-TCP proxy, or a regional relay we control. Each has tradeoffs.

Nina: Constraints from support: many customers only allow TCP 443; some forbid kernel modules; others disallow new visible IPs. That drives a multi-mode shim.

Theo: Proposal: shim negotiation order: 1) encapsulation that preserves src (wg/vxlan), 2) UDP userland (DTLS) if UDP allowed, 3) TLS/TCP fallback with signed metadata envelope for attribution. Shim publishes active transport to CP.

Priya: Signed envelope idea: when src IP is lost, shim attaches a short-lived signed JSON with tenant_id, agent_id, install_ts, transport, and signature. This lets logs/authz trace back to tenant without relying on src IP.

Liam: Key mgmt: Option A customer-provided keys; Option B CP-issued ephemeral certs via onboarding token. B is smoother but needs onboarding flow work.

ops-bot: cost spike: https://ci/internal/relays/egress-estimates.csv (uploaded).

Nina: Observability: shim must expose /metrics, /health, and emit transport-change events to tracing. Also include a /debug/state endpoint guarded by short-lived token.

Theo: Fail-open rules: agent must prefer privatelink when healthy. If privatelink timeouts >=3, switch to shim with backoff. If shim error rate high, auto-disable and alert.

Priya: Spikes and owners:
- wg-preserve-src: Liam + Theo (2w)
- dtls-udp-userland: Nina (1w)
- tls-envelope: Priya (3d)
Includes tests for src-IP fidelity and envelope verification.

Liam: Rollout: opt-in beta for Private customers. Pilot 3 customers first, then expand. Finance wants relay egress chargeback if we use regional relays.

Nina: Cloud caveats: AWS TGW/Privatelink routing will need special handling for VXLAN; Azure may block UDP; GCP PSC needs DNS mapping. Document per-provider.

Priya: Dedicated CPs: shim must be configurable to point to hosted or dedicated endpoints at install-time.

Theo: I'll draft the negotiation state machine and minimal config schema.

ops-bot: ticket RELAY-SHIM-101 created: https://tickets/internal/RELAY-SHIM-101

Priya: Thanks. Sync next Tue to pick default beta mode.
